before.title_zh: 智慧的协同修正与慧根
before.title_en: Coordinated correction in wisdom and huigen
before.claim_zh: 智慧协同因果理解、有根据的关切与可实行回应，并能够修正事实、排除规则和阻断纠正的权力。
before.claim_en: Wisdom coordinates causal understanding, warranted concern and feasible response while revising facts, exclusion rules and power that blocks correction.
before.scope_zh: 有界条件综合已接受；慧根的必要性、全部伦理内容与普遍智慧未证明。 形式支撑后续修复：原15项查询定理与1项辅助重证均为空依赖；连同实际自定义依赖，六模块63项审计全空。此修复不升级慧根或伦理的普遍必要性。
before.scope_en: Bounded conditional synthesis accepted; huigen's necessity, full ethical content and universal wisdom remain unproved. Formal-support repair: the fifteen original inquiry theorems and one helper reproof have empty reports; their six-module logical/inquiry closure has 63 empty audits. This does not upgrade universal huigen or ethical necessity.

links.label_zh: 智慧的协同修正与慧根
links.label_en: Coordinated correction in wisdom and huigen

before.connection_zh: 将共同形成推进为理解、评价、行动及其修订条件的协同。
before.connection_en: Extends co-formation to coordination among understanding, evaluation, action and their conditions of revision.

after.title_zh: 智慧的协同修正与慧根
after.title_en: Coordinated correction in wisdom and huigen
after.claim_zh: 智慧协同因果理解、有根据的关切与可实行回应，并能够修正事实、排除规则和阻断纠正的权力。 本轮接续说明同一要求可有相反回应，前次成功也可实际改变下一步的条件。
after.claim_en: Wisdom coordinates causal understanding, warranted concern and feasible response while revising facts, exclusion rules and power that blocks correction. A contextual continuation shows opposite responses under one requirement, including a reversal caused by the previous response’s success.
after.scope_zh: 有界条件综合已接受；慧根的必要性、全部伦理内容与普遍智慧未证明。 形式支撑后续修复：原15项查询定理与1项辅助重证均为空依赖；连同实际自定义依赖，六模块63项审计全空。此修复不升级慧根或伦理的普遍必要性。 新11项定理／50项含依赖审计（44空、6标准），两组熟悉原典及不利案例按范围比较；未作盲法预测或证明伦理根据同一。
after.scope_en: Bounded conditional synthesis accepted; huigen's necessity, full ethical content and universal wisdom remain unproved. Formal-support repair: the fifteen original inquiry theorems and one helper reproof have empty reports; their six-module logical/inquiry closure has 63 empty audits. This does not upgrade universal huigen or ethical necessity. Eleven new theorems / fifty import-inclusive audits (44 empty, 6 standard); two familiar primary-text comparisons retain adverse details. No blind prediction or identity of ethical grounds is claimed.

links.label_zh: 智慧的协同修正与慧根
links.label_en: Coordinated correction in wisdom and huigen

after.connection_zh: 将共同形成推进为理解、评价、行动及其修订条件的协同。
after.connection_en: Extends co-formation to coordination among understanding, evaluation, action and their conditions of revision.

before.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
before.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。
before.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound.
before.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；共享上下文、及时性与忠实抽象待继续比较。
before.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; shared contexts, timeliness and faithful abstraction remain for comparison.

after.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
after.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。
after.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success.
after.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；共享上下文、及时性与忠实抽象待继续比较。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。
after.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; shared contexts, timeliness and faithful abstraction remain for comparison. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate.
